checklist.claim: Property docstring: a failed open finishing after a concurrent successful one cannot leave open_error set. Falsify via thread interleavings of _get_client.
checklist.source_excerpt:
Reads ``None`` whenever a client is open, so a failed open that finishes
        after a concurrent successful one (two executor threads) cannot leave it set.
checklist.verify_hint: Build interleavings; confirm property returns None once _client set.
checklist.evidence: agent_memory.py:154-164: open_error returns None if self._client is not None, else _open_error. _client is assigned only at :123 (init None) and :151 (success), never reset to None. So once any thread succeeds, a later failing thread (sets _open_error at :148) cannot make the property return non-None. Failing before the success also is overwritten by :150. Only a transient window between :150 and :151 exists, not a failure finishing after success.
